about.title: About Energeia
about.subtitle: Cyprus All-Energy Network & Collaboration Hub
about.text1: Energeia is the leading professional energy directory and intelligence network in Cyprus, uniting certified auditors, engineers, installation firms, and regulatory specialists under a unified digital collaboration space.
about.text2: We facilitate knowledge sharing, direct contracting, policy mapping, and continuous professional training to accelerate the transition to sustainable energy markets in the Eastern Mediterranean.

pwa.title: Energeia on your home screen
pwa.description: Get instant one-tap access to Cyprus energy news, real-time market updates, and the verified professional member directory.
pwa.installGenericAlert: To install, open your browser options/settings and select 'Add to Home Screen' or 'Install app'.
pwa.iosDescription: Follow these simple steps in Safari to add Energeia to your device's home screen:
pwa.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's bottom toolbar.
pwa.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
pwa.iosStep3: Tap Add in the top-right corner to complete installation.
pwa.pushDescription: Get instant push notifications on your lock screen and timely updates right on your home screen icon.
pwa.pushNotSupported: Push notifications are not supported by your current browser.
